description:
Write the researcher-facing documentation: crate-level rustdoc and runnable examples covering concise primitive binary construction, fully explicit nonbinary general construction, systematic encoding, matrix materialization and saving, coordinate conventions, error contracts, complexity, and performance-path selection.

## Background

The designed distance is documented as a guaranteed lower bound, never the minimum distance unless independently established. Examples compile as doctests or example binaries under the fast-tier budget.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Runnable examples cover the concise binary case and the fully explicit nonbinary case end to end, including matrix saving through the canonical format.
- [hard] REQ-02: Rustdoc covers coordinate conventions, error contracts, decoder guarantees, complexity, and performance-path selection, with the distance-bound terminology observed throughout.
title: Researcher-oriented rustdoc and runnable examples
